[SWS_DM_00357] Validity/lifetime of a Notification Request
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
A notification request registered at a UDS Transport Protocol implementation ac-
cording to [SWS_DM_00356] is valid only for the next call to
apext::diag::uds_
transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler::Start
until the following call to
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler::Stop
of
this UDS Transport Protocol implementation.
⌋
